_note: Run premise. Every run: you carry a P.A.U.S.E. unit, the Sentinels hunt you, get it home. Home, start crew and the opening dialog depend on the start faction (more factions / start ships later).

company.name: PROMETHEUS ATOMIC
company.about: Pre-war company that built every atomic reactor in America (homes, cars, airships). Also built P.A.U.S.E.

pause.about: Stops time in one fight (like V.A.T.S.). Very rare, cannot be rebuilt – the knowledge is lost. Others may own one too.
